scripts.check: corepack pnpm build:packages && corepack pnpm contract:check && corepack pnpm check:docs && corepack pnpm check:format && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test:tooling
scripts.build: corepack pnpm -r run build && node scripts/check-miniapp-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r run test && corepack pnpm test:integration
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @caau/database build && corepack pnpm --filter @caau/api dev
scripts.dev:admin: corepack pnpm --filter @caau/api-client build && corepack pnpm --filter @caau/admin dev
scripts.dev:miniapp: corepack pnpm --filter @caau/api-client build && corepack pnpm --filter @caau/miniapp dev
scripts.check:format: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json tsconfig*.json *.mjs playwright.config.ts scripts apps/*/src apps/*/test apps/*/config apps/admin/e2e apps/*/*.json apps/*/*.ts apps/*/*.cjs apps/admin/index.html packages/api-client/src packages/api-client/test packages/api-client/*.json database/src/index.ts database/test database/*.json database/*.ts deploy/*.yml .github/workflows/*.yml --ignore-unknown
